claims: Obtain a 12-lead ECG to evaluate for myocardial ischemia given markedly elevated CK (4561 IU/L) with elevated CK-MB (14 ng/mL) and mildly elevated troponin-T.
Repeat troponin and CK-MB measurements to assess for a rising pattern indicating acute myocardial injury.
Continue telemetry and ST-segment monitoring for arrhythmia and ischemia detection.
Recheck serum magnesium and replete if still low, as magnesium is 1.5 mg/dL.
Monitor blood glucose closely and treat hyperglycemia, as glucose is 226 mg/dL.
Assess and manage pain with the existing PCA regimen, as pain is currently moderate to severe.
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent pulmonary complications given bedfast status.
Maintain oxygen therapy to keep SpO2 above 90%, as current SpO2 is 96% on supplemental oxygen.
Perform regular skin care and repositioning to prevent pressure injury, as Braden score indicates risk.
Monitor liver enzymes (AST 130, ALT 132) with repeat testing to assess trend.
